description: Measured equivalences between fast-lane source files. Each entry says a file's new sha256 computes byte-identically to an earlier one; the lane identity hashes the earliest. Append-only. A change that moves any feature byte gets no entry.

equivalences.evidence: Measured on node2 (8xB200), old source 3ba9794 against the new: the vLLM install check identical at 3b, 8b and 70b under unchanged lane ids; reduce_capture byte-identical on 64 retained 70B captures (32 native, 32 null); the fast lane byte-identical on 8 70B rows with lane id unchanged (torch-eager-reduce-v1-fa7e1942eea837a5fea0); the gate top-k equal to the frozen earlier form on tie-forced surfaces (tests/test_gate_topk_equivalence.py). Records: node2:/models/anamnesis-vllm-integration/readout-p2-001/{install2-*,readout-compare,fast-compare}.
